data.name: 告死天使招魂令 Death Angel Requiem
data.detailed_description:
Your story begins to kill people after you "die".

Six years ago, the creator "Han Shi", who was both a genius and notorious, met a social death.

Six years later, the investigator "Igarashi" was entrusted by the police and arrived at the scene of the murder.

What was left at the crime scene was:

Four corpses, each with a distinct and bizarre death scene.

The summoning ritual of the "Death Angel" in fictional works, and the birth date and eight characters of a deceased person that do not belong to anyone present.

An entire school, a group of students who grew up alongside the dark past and works of "Han Shi".

Together with her lively younger sister and partner "Shimo", she is entrusted by the police to unravel this murderous plot woven with others' pasts.

Facing murderers and fanboys who regard others as symbols for consumption and disguise bloody crimes as supernatural events,

Facing the evil gathered due to this work,

The only thing she knows for sure is:

The murderer is using someone else's "legacy" to commit a real murder.

This work marks the culmination of the "Angel of Death" series after a six-year hiatus.

 

Game type: Semi-visual novel/plot exploration

Game duration: less than 4 hours

Game ending: Single ending, but various exploration achievements can be collected

Operation method: Use arrow keys to move, shift to run, and press Esc and X to pop up the menu. You can play in full screen or operate with the mouse only.

Archiving method: Manual archiving at designated locations.

(PS: Due to insufficient funds, unfortunately, only two female protagonists have been provided with voice acting. We hope you can still have a good gaming experience.)
